module.timezone.name: TSQ Time Converter
module.timezone.description: Shows a time (default: Türkiye) in other time zones and as a Discord timestamp: /saat 21:00 [timezone:pdt].
cmd.saat: Convert a time to other time zones
cmd.saat.time: Time or now, e.g. 21:00, 9.30 or now (Türkiye time unless a time zone is given)
timezone.title: 🕐 Time Converter
timezone.unavailable: Time zone data is not available right now. Please try again later.
cmd.saat.timezone: Time zone of the entered time (default: Türkiye), e.g. tr, pdt, est, uk, utc
timezone.invalid_zone: Enter a valid time zone. Example: tr, pdt, est, cst, uk or utc.
timezone.skipped_time: This time does not exist in the chosen time zone because of a daylight saving time change.
timezone.repeated_time: This time happens twice in the chosen time zone because of a daylight saving time change, so it could mean two different moments. Enter another time or use timezone:utc.
cmd.saat.date: Date, e.g. 15.11 or 15.11.2026 (default: today in that time zone)
cmd.saat.to: Convert only to this time zone, e.g. tr, uk, est, pdt, tokyo
timezone.invalid_date: Enter a valid date. Example: 15.11 or 15.11.2026
timezone.invalid_target: Enter a valid target time zone. Example: tr, uk, est, pdt, tokyo or utc.
timezone.now_with_date: The date option cannot be used together with time:now.
